title: The model boundary
goal: Read every model response once, where it enters your code, and turn it into a result with a status. Then turn the routing reply into checked data, so a cut-off, refused, or malformed reply never reaches the rest of the assistant, even when the schema went missing.
checks: reads each finish_reason as its status, with the text and the usage
reads a refusal as refused, whatever its finish_reason
throws for a finish_reason it doesn't know
reads a route only from a complete result
rejects a route that doesn't match the schema
checks the shape of JSON the schema would have stopped, such as null

title: Streaming and tools
goal: Build a streamed answer from its typed events, so only a finish event finishes it. Then give the model an order lookup that takes the customer and the shop from the session, and answer every tool call with a checked, safe tool message.
checks: takes the status only from a finish event, so a dropped stream stays interrupted
keeps the usage unknown when the stream ends before its usage event
stops at an error event, and skips event types it doesn't handle
looks up the session customer's own order, with only the fields the answer needs
answers another customer's order and a missing one the same way, whatever the arguments say
keeps one email's orders apart in each shop
runs only the tools on its list
passes the tool the session from the login, whatever the arguments say
answers every call with a tool message that names its id, failed calls too

title: Retrieval
goal: Search pgvector in one query for the chunks of the session's shop and current versions only, so neither another shop's chunk nor a rolled-back version comes back. Answer from the close ones with their ids, hand off when nothing is close, and check that every citation names a chunk the request sent.
checks: searches only the session's shop
searches only the current version of each document
leaves out a newer version the shop rolled back
returns at most the limit, nearest first, with ties in id order
hands a question with no chunk within 0.55 to a person, without a model call
sends only the chunks within 0.55, at most 4, each with its id
asks with the instructions, the answer schema, a token limit, and the question in its tags
rejects an answer with no citations, or one that cites a chunk that wasn't sent
hands off a reply that isn't complete, isn't JSON, or says the sources don't answer

title: Evals
goal: Measure retrieval with hit rate, recall@k, and MRR on labeled questions, and grade answers with code checks before a model judge. Then compare each run with the score to beat, where only a case the baseline passed can break.
checks: scores hit rate and recall per question, so one that found 1 of its 3 chunks counts
takes MRR from each question's first relevant chunk, in the whole ranking
leaves the questions with no relevant chunk out of the retrieval metrics
fails an answer on the code checks first, then on the judge's verdict
grades a judge result without a clear verdict as ungraded, never as a pass
counts the ungraded cases as not passed in the pass rate
lists the cases the baseline passed and this run fails
leaves a case the baseline never had out of broken

title: Refunds
goal: Let the model only propose a refund of the customer's own order, and pay only what a support agent approved: the same arguments, by the same agent, before the expiry, once, with one approval per proposal. Replayed injection transcripts must fail.
checks: stores a proposal and pays nothing
proposes only the customer's own order, for 1 cent up to its total
binds the approval to a copy of the proposal's arguments, the agent, an expiry, and a key
refuses to pay an order or an amount the approval didn't cover
refuses an unknown approval, another agent's, or an expired one
pays a retried command once, whatever order its fields come in
approves each proposal once, so a double approval can't pay twice
fails every call of the replayed injection transcripts, and pays nothing

title: Budgets and traces
goal: Reserve each model call's worst-case cost before it runs, against the user's plan and a global limit, and settle it to its usage, or keep the reservation when the usage is missing or the call throws. Then price a request's trace, with the cost from usage kept apart from the estimate.
checks: reserves against the user's plan limit, then the global limit
lets only the calls that fit reach the model when three arrive at once
settles to the usage, or keeps the reservation when usage never arrives
charges nothing more for a settle sent twice
makes no call over the budget, and charges a call without usage its reservation
keeps a failed call's reservation, and passes its error on
keeps a trace's cost from usage apart from its estimated cost
counts only model spans, so a trace without them costs nothing
